plugins.name: ZCode / GLM Coding Plan
plugins.description: Adds ZCode / GLM Coding Plan as a CLIProxyAPI provider with relay (OAuth), ultra and bigmodel_direct upstreams. Auto mode prefers the relay trial plan, routes only the models it covers, caps relay concurrency at 1 and sends overflow straight to the normal channel. Ships an embedded usage dashboard.
plugins.author: colemak

zh-CN.description: 把 ZCode / GLM Coding Plan 账号接成 CLIProxyAPI provider：支持 relay（OAuth）、ultra、bigmodel_direct 三种上游。auto 模式优先体验套餐，只把套餐覆盖的模型路由到 relay，并发上限 1，超出立刻回落正常渠道；内置用量看板。
